PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.

3. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

8. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
